summary.text: Shane Sawyer is a independent candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 128 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sawyer is a small business owner and Army Reserve veteran who serves as a Ward 1 alderman in Bolivar, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Shane Sawyer graduated from Bolivar High School and served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 2014 to 2020.
In his Ballotpedia survey, Sawyer said he was born in Bolivar, Missouri, is married with two children, and owns a small business.
He said he is Ward 1 alderman for the City of Bolivar and previously served on the Bolivar Special Road District Commission, including two years as chairman.
Sawyer is running as an independent in the 2026 general election.
In the survey, he said his top priorities include protecting residents from rising utility rates, opposing the construction of hyper-scale data centers, and fully funding public schools.
